title: Correlate admission with actual emitted occupancy
description:
Correlate production admission/accounting with observed emissions under specifically approved sustained and failure workloads. Cover complete control, data, forwarding, retry and applicable experimental parity/header traffic, physical-frequency aliases, plan transitions and recovery. Do not duplicate production ledgers or claim a smoke exchange proves occupancy enforcement.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Require affirmative matching authority.10/rf.03 approvals for the exact workload before ports or RF. Experimental traffic also requires its specific human profile/security gates. No priority/SOS or failure path bypass is permitted; denied/mismatched clearance leaves execution blocked or deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Independent RF interval observations match authority.06 expectations and the declared configured constraints. Record allowed and denied TX, partial-window boundaries, restart/clock behavior and zero-delivery cases. admission.14 and ci.15 establish software provenance, not the physical measurement oracle.
